title: 第11章 西殿公子易清澜第12章 被羞辱的人成了自己
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
回到寒露殿后，白露就想让自己的手下去寻找菩提心的下落。
结果常潇却是上前一步，对着白露恭敬的说道:“主上，那蔺兰舟提的条件太过于苛刻。”
“实在是不把主上您放在心上啊。”
“现在灵界的大多数人都知那菩提心是传说中灵族的圣物。”
“已经消失了万年之久，怎么可能轻易让主上您找到呢？”
“况且还给了那么短的时间。”
“这简直是在侮辱你主上您啊……”闻言，已经慵懒地倚回软榻上的白露，不由得轻轻挑了挑秀气的柳眉。
在她的印象里，无论是左护法还是右护法，向来都不是多嘴之人。
今日怎地如此一反常态？
莫不是……她这位左护法担忧蔺兰舟日后地位尊崇，会威胁到他的权力？
因此才这般急切地给蔺兰舟泼脏水？
白露在心中思来想去，似乎只寻得这一个合理的解释。
她煞有其事地暗自点头：绝对就是这个缘由！
在合欢宗内，除却她这位宗主，权势最盛的便是左右护法了。
倘若她此刻多出一位道侣，那么属于左右护法的部分权力，自然会被分出去……
看来，自己还需寻个时机，给这两位下属吃颗定心丸才是。
否则，若因此令他们生出异心，反倒不美。
虽说以她如今化神期后期巅峰的修为，放眼整个灵界已难觅敌手，但宗门内部的安稳同样重要。
思及此处，白露在软榻上换了个更舒适的姿势，红唇轻启：“左护法，不必忧心。”
“此事，本座心中自有考量。”

“你们当下要务，是在最短时日内，探明菩提心的下落。”
“虽说本座与他皆已立下天地誓言，受天道约束……”白露话锋一转，清冽的凤眸中掠过一丝狡黠。
“但谁说……将他归还浮云剑宗之后，本座就不能再次将他请回来了呢？”
她微微停顿，语气骤然变得冰冷：“不过，待本座第二次将他带回这合欢宗时，他便再无资格做什么道侣……”
“只能乖乖做本座的炉鼎！”最后一句落下，白露周身瞬间爆发出一股令人窒息的恐怖威压！
这股磅礴的威压虽只持续了一瞬，却已让侍立下方的常潇与墨竹脸色骤然变得苍白如纸。
然而，常潇低垂的眼眸深处，非但没有恐惧，反而飞快地闪过一丝难以抑制的欣喜！
看来主上对那蔺兰舟的皮相，也不过是略感兴趣，才动了结为道侣的念头
但若此子胆敢不识抬举，再三忤逆主上……
那他的下场，必将惨烈无比！
心念电转间，常潇嘴角微扬，立刻摆出无比恭顺的姿态，躬身应道：“主上思虑周全，算无遗策，属下拜服。”
“行了行了，无需多言。”白露慵懒地挥了挥手“你二人速速退下吧。”
“记住，三日之内，本座要知晓菩提心的踪迹。”
“遵命，主上！”常潇与墨竹不敢有丝毫怠慢，齐声应诺。
话音未落，两人身影便已化作两道流光，瞬息间便飞遁远去。
察觉到两人的气息彻底远去，白露的神经瞬间放松下来。
content_en:
After returning to Hanlu Hall, Bai Lu wanted her men to find the whereabouts of Bodhicitta.
As a result, Chang Xiao took a step forward and said respectfully to Bai Lu: "My lord, the conditions proposed by Lin Lanzhou are too harsh."
"I really don't take you to heart, my lord."
"Most people in the spirit world now know that Bodhicitta is the legendary sacred object of the spirit race."
"It has been missing for thousands of years, how could it be easily found by you, my lord?"
"Besides, we were given such a short time."
"This is simply an insult to your lord..." Hearing this, Bai Lu, who had lazily leaned back on the soft couch, could not help but slightly raise her delicate eyebrows.
In her impression, neither the Left Protector nor the Right Protector were talkative people.
Why is it so unusual today?
Could it be that...she, the Zuo Guardian, was worried that Lin Lanzhou's high status in the future would threaten his power?
Is that why you are so eager to throw dirty water on Lin Lanzhou?
Bai Lu thought about it in her heart and seemed to only find this one reasonable explanation.
She nodded to herself with seriousness: This is definitely the reason!
Within the Hehuan Sect, apart from her as the sect leader, the most powerful person is the left and right guardians.
If she had one more Taoist companion at this moment, then part of the power belonging to the left and right guardians would naturally be divided...
It seems that I still need to find an opportunity to give these two subordinates some reassurance.
Otherwise, it would be unsightly if it causes them to have a different mind.
Although it is difficult for her to find an opponent in the entire spiritual world with her current peak cultivation level in the late stage of the Divine Transformation Stage, the stability within the sect is equally important.
Thinking of this, Bai Lu changed to a more comfortable position on the soft couch, her red lips parted lightly: "Guardian Zuo, don't worry."
"I have my own thoughts on this matter."
"Your immediate priority is to find out the whereabouts of bodhicitta within the shortest possible time."
"Although I and he have both made an oath to heaven and earth and are bound by the laws of heaven..." Bai Lu changed the topic, and a hint of cunning flashed in her clear phoenix eyes.
"But who said... that after returning him to Fuyun Sword Sect, I can't invite him back again?"
She paused slightly, and her tone suddenly became cold: "However, when I bring him back to the Hehuan Sect for the second time, he will no longer be qualified to be a Taoist companion..."
"You can only be my cauldron!" After the last sentence, a suffocating and terrifying pressure suddenly burst out from Bai Lu's body!
Although this majestic pressure only lasted for a moment, Chang Xiao and Mo Zhu, who were standing below, suddenly turned pale as paper.
However, in the depths of Chang Xiao's lowered eyes, not only was there no fear, but a flash of uncontrollable joy quickly flashed through!
It seems that the Lord was only slightly interested in Lin Lanzhou's appearance before he came up with the idea of becoming a Taoist couple.
But if this son dares to ignore the praise and disobey the Lord again and again...
Then his end will be extremely tragic!
As his mind was spinning, Chang Xiao raised the corner of his mouth slightly, immediately put on a very respectful posture, bowed and responded: "My Lord has thought carefully and has left no stone unturned. I will obey you."
"Okay, okay, no need to say anything more." Bai Lu waved her hand lazily, "You two, please leave quickly."
"Remember, within three days, I will know the traces of bodhicitta."
"As you command, Your Majesty!" Chang Xiao and Mo Zhu agreed in unison without any hesitation.
Before they finished speaking, the two figures turned into two streams of light and flew away in an instant.
Realizing that the breath of the two people was completely gone, Bai Lu's nerves instantly relaxed.
